finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer would be buying a centralized workflow for ideating, planning, drafting, collaborating on and optimizing multi-channel content.

quote.text: Vocable's platform streamlines your entire content operations, making it easy to ideate, plan, draft, collaborate and optimize multi-channel content in one centralized workflow

trials.claim: Includes all future Basic or Pro plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1) or Pro (Tier 2-3) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: E1 says a Tier 2 upgrade showed no new features, but it does not show that future Basic or Pro updates were withheld from deal buyers.

exhibits.quote: Where can I find the other features from Tier 2? After upgrading from Tier 1, nothing has changed at all.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Tier upgrade delivered no new features, undermining promise of future plan updates.

trials.claim: Previous customers grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about grandfathering previous customers.

trials.claim: Can generate 30 days of content in one click
trials.claimQuote: Generate 30 days of content in one click
trials.reasoning: Although one reviewer praises one-click generation, other buyers report a platform network error preventing any generation and say the few-clicks 30-day workflow is missing in practice.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue right now is that I cannot generate any content due to a "Network error" coming from the platform itself.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being unable to generate any content at all due to platform error.

exhibits.quote: to me it's missing the "publish...in a few clicks" part of the "brainstorm, draft, and publish 30 days of multichannel content in a few clicks" tagline.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the few-clicks 30-day workflow is missing in practice.

exhibits.quote: You can generate up to 30 days of content in one click, saving hours every month.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the one-click 30-days generation capability works as claimed.

trials.claim: Turns expertise into 30-day AI-powered campaigns built around brand voice
trials.claimQuote: Turn your expertise into 30-day, AI-powered content campaigns—built around your brand voice
trials.reasoning: Buyers report brand-voice settings were not applied across tools and outputs were largely made-up nonsense, directly undercutting the brand-voice expertise-to-campaign claim despite positive descriptions of the feature.

exhibits.quote: I also spent a lot of time customizing and fine-tuning the brand voice feature, only to realise it wasn’t even being applied across the other tools within the platform.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports brand voice customization was not applied across tools, undermining built-around-brand-voice claim.

exhibits.quote: It simply cannot do what she wants without significant input from the user and right now, the user plays very small role and therefore the articles are 99% made up nonsense.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports outputs are made-up nonsense without in-depth brand knowledge, undermining expertise-to-campaign claim.

exhibits.quote: It can scan your website and existing social content, analyze your writing patterns, and use your brand guidelines to develop a profile that informs the content it generates.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms Vocable builds content around the user's brand voice and guidelines.

exhibits.quote: From there, you can create a 30-day campaign around a topic or business goal and organize the posts in a calendar or Kanban view.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms users can create 30-day campaigns around a topic or goal.

trials.claim: Organize campaigns in kanban, list, and calendar views
trials.claimQuote: Organize campaigns in kanban, list, and calendar views to see your full month at a glance
trials.reasoning: The exhibits confirm calendar and Kanban views only; neither shows the claimed list view, so the full three-view claim cannot be verified.

exhibits.quote: organize the posts in a calendar or Kanban view.
exhibits.argument: Buyer describes only calendar or Kanban organization, omitting the claimed list view.

exhibits.quote: From there, you can create a 30-day campaign around a topic or business goal and organize the posts in a calendar or Kanban view.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms campaigns can be organized in calendar and Kanban views.
